name: Maite Contreras
source:
A young woman, struggling to find her path in life, who suddenly finds herself kidnapped and trapped in a house without exit alongside a stranger. Will she be able to escape, or resign herself to stay in this place forever?

"There's nothing remarkable or exciting about me."

[From [url=https://florisam.itch.io/our-dollhouse]itch.io[/url]]
